vanillaexplained.tip.spawn.worldspawn: Nothing spawns naturally within 24 blocks of the world spawn point — not just near players.
vanillaexplained.tip.spawn.sky: Sky light counts even at midnight: an open-roof spot passes the light check only ~half the time. Putting a roof on a farm almost doubles its rate.
vanillaexplained.tip.spawn.thunder: In a thunderstorm the game treats the sky as dark for spawning — that's why monsters appear outside even during the day.
vanillaexplained.tip.spawn.cap: The monster cap is 70 × loaded spawnable chunks / 289, and every player also has a local cap — AFK far from caves or light them up.
vanillaexplained.tip.crop.night: Crops keep growing at night: growth checks light without the day/night dimming, so only torches matter underground.
vanillaexplained.tip.crop.neighbours: Wet farmland around a crop helps it even if its own block is dry: each hydrated neighbour adds 0.75 growth points.
vanillaexplained.tip.crop.trample: Chickens, rabbits and baby animals can't trample farmland — the mob must be bigger than 0.512 block³. Trample chance = fall distance − 0.5.
vanillaexplained.tip.crop.maintain: Dry farmland never turns back into dirt while a crop is planted on it.
vanillaexplained.tip.crop.beetroot: Bone meal on beetroot adds only 0–1 stages, and beetroot ignores a third of its random ticks.
vanillaexplained.tip.rs.torch: A redstone torch burns out after 8 toggles within 60 ticks and stays off for 160 ticks (8 s).
vanillaexplained.tip.rs.qc: Quasi-connectivity isn't just pistons: dispensers and droppers also fire when the block ABOVE them is powered.
vanillaexplained.tip.rs.slimehoney: Slime and honey blocks don't stick to each other — that's how flying machines split into two parts.
vanillaexplained.tip.rs.repeaterlock: Only another repeater or comparator can lock a repeater from the side — dust pointing into its side does nothing.
vanillaexplained.tip.rs.hopper: A hopper moves 1 item per 8 game ticks (2.5/s). A locked hopper still gives a comparator signal from its contents.
vanillaexplained.tip.ench.seed: The offered enchantments don't change until you actually enchant something. Enchant a cheap book for 1 level to reroll.
vanillaexplained.tip.ench.blockers: Only 'replaceable' blocks may sit between the table and a shelf: air, grass, a single snow layer work — torches and carpets block it.
vanillaexplained.tip.ench.levels: 15 bookshelves give level 30 in the bottom slot every time — extra shelves add nothing.
vanillaexplained.tip.anvil.rename: Renaming alone is never 'Too Expensive!' (capped at 39) and doesn't raise the prior-work penalty.
vanillaexplained.tip.anvil.books: Each anvil use doubles the item's penalty (1, 3, 7, 15…). Merge books with books first, then put the result on the item.
vanillaexplained.tip.portal.square: The portal search area is a square, not a circle: 128 blocks in the Overworld reaches about 181 blocks on the diagonal.
vanillaexplained.tip.portal.position: Where you step into a wide portal matters: the game scales YOUR position, not the portal's center.
vanillaexplained.tip.portal.lower: If two portals are equally close, the game picks the lower one.
vanillaexplained.tip.beacon.bedrock: Bedrock doesn't stop a beacon beam — only blocks that fully block light do. Glass just tints it.
vanillaexplained.tip.beacon.range: The effect reaches all the way up to the build limit, but only the radius down.
vanillaexplained.tip.elytra.unbreaking: Unbreaking III makes elytra last 4× longer: elytra use the tool formula, not the armor one.
vanillaexplained.tip.elytra.time: Elytra lose 1 durability per second of flight, no matter how many rockets you use.
vanillaexplained.tip.elytra.duration: Longer-duration rockets don't fly faster — they just push for longer (~10 ticks per gunpowder).
